description: A lace-booster that runs your wetware past the red line. Smoke may be metaphorical.

effects.onset_message: Your lace warms up. You think faster than you ever have.

overdose.message: Your lace runs too hot for too long, and something in your brain burns out.

phases.comeup_message: Your lace spins up with a whine only you can hear. You start seeing everything as numbers.
phases.end_message: Your thinking slows back to normal. You've got a pounding headache.
phases.peak_message: You're thinking about a dozen things at once, and it's too much.

withdrawal.message: Your thinking is slow and heavy. You want another dose.

stages.easing: Your thoughts start lining up again, slowly and out of order.
stages.onset: The lace goes quiet, like a fan you'd stopped noticing switching off.
stages.peak: Every thought you'd put aside comes back at once, far too many to keep track of.
stages.rising: You reach for something you know and for a second it isn't there.
stages.tail: You think at your normal speed now. You still catch yourself waiting for the faster one.

name: Neural Overclock
